title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: DSC 106 team project. Using Guttmacher Institute data, we built one visualization arguing that abortion access in the U.S. is severely restricted and one arguing that it is not, from the same cleaned dataset, then reflected on where persuasion becomes deception. Python, Pandas, Plotly.

title: Power Outage Analysis
description: Analyzed 1,534 U.S. power outage events (2000–2016) to test whether severe weather causes significantly longer outages using permutation-based hypothesis testing. Python, Pandas, Plotly, Scikit-learn.

title: Modeling Medical Costs Using Demographic and Lifestyle Factors
description: Built regression models to identify which demographic and lifestyle factors most strongly predict individual medical costs; conducted feature analysis and model evaluation. Python, Pandas, Plotly, Scikit-learn.

title: What Drives Popularity in Sports Nutrition Supplements?
description: Investigated product attributes associated with Amazon supplement popularity using review count as a proxy; applied log transformation and category-level analysis across two datasets. Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn.

title: Calendar Widget
description: Built a desktop calendar widget with a language toggle and daily quotes from the ZenQuotes API. HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
